users.description: Supports multiple users for the future; the MVP only ever has one row, seeded on first boot.

boards.description: One board per user for the MVP, enforced by the UNIQUE constraint on user_id.

columns.user_id: INTEGER NOT NULL UNIQUE REFERENCES users(id)

columns.description: The Kanban board's fixed columns. id is a stable string (e.g. 'col-backlog') matching the frontend's Column.id, not an autoincrement integer, so it round-trips directly with the frontend's BoardData shape.

cards.description: A card belongs to exactly one column. position replaces the frontend's Column.cardIds array — ordering within a column is 'ORDER BY position' instead of an id list.
